Module output for `module-x12-x12`'s synthetic fixtures
(`package/x12/x12/java/src/test/resources/fixtures/*.x12` in zerobias-org/module), as served by
the module: the materialized transaction plus its envelope overlay (`elementKey`, control numbers,
`senderId`, `interchangeDate`, …). The data is synthetic. The x12.org examples are X12 IP and
are not committed here.

Regenerate after a materializer change by running the module's `Materializer` over the same
fixture files and re-adding the envelope fields.
